markets.rules_secondary:
Player Participation & Settlement Criteria
If Freddy Peralta is scratched or is not a starting pitcher, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Freddy Peralta is not a starting pitcher but later enters the game, the market will resolve to the fair market price, relief appearances will not count towards this market.
If Freddy Peralta is a starting pitcher and records at least one batter faced the market will settle based on earned runs recorded.
